author: jake
narrative: SUBJECT ANA MARIA RUIZ is a citizen of Honduras. On 03/19/2025 Border Patrol agents encountered the subject near Eagle Pass, Texas. Subject stated she crossed the Rio Grande on foot between ports of entry and was not admitted or paroled. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: jake
narrative: ALIEN FARID HASSAN, a citizen of Sudan, was ordered removed on 08/12/2020 and departed the United States pursuant to that order. On 01/15/2025 he reentered the United States without being admitted. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(9)(A)(i).

author: jake
narrative: NATALIA VEGA submitted a fraudulent birth certificate in support of an immigration application. The document falsely stated her identity, which was material to the benefit sought. Subject sought immigration benefits through willful misrepresentation and is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(C)(i).

author: jake
